name: Concordia (Magdalena, Colombia)
description: Four horizontal stripes of blue, yellow, green and blue, each charged with a white five-pointed star towards the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Concordia, a municipality in the department of Magdalena, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: one star on each stripe towards the fly
